intent: User-selected combination: concept 2 portrait layout, concept 1 side buttons, concept 3 bottom USB-C; two enclosure constructions
variant_a_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / industrial product concept.
Create one coherent revised product, based on these three supplied concept photographs. This is a precise user-directed combination, not a new unrelated design.
Input image roles:
IMAGE 1 (wide device with orange round button): reference ONLY for the side-button arrangement and the understated aluminum perimeter / inset face relationship.
IMAGE 2 (upright device with green sliding switch): PRIMARY EDIT TARGET. Preserve its VERTICAL PORTRAIT body silhouette, continuous soft corners, square screen in the upper front, quiet lower front label area, compact thickness and disciplined 1960s Braun / Dieter Rams industrial design.
IMAGE 3 (square silver device with blue side button): reference ONLY for the USB-C placement in the actual BOTTOM END FACE and the camera view that exposes that bottom face.

Required common revision:
Keep image 2's portrait FRONT layout and vertical proportions. A square 2.0-inch AMOLED, not a tall rectangular screen. The square screen remains in the upper front, with two tiny black Helvetica lines "RID" and "Model R-2" at the lower left of the front panel.
Completely replace image 2's green slider and AUTO/HOLD marks with image 1's physical button arrangement: on the RIGHT SIDE WALL, an approximately 8 mm orange CIRCULAR target-lock pushbutton ABOVE a neutral light-gray VERTICAL CAPSULE up/down rocker. Orange round button has one simple black lock icon, tiny black "LOCK" below it. The gray rocker has black up/down triangles. Preserve generous functional separation. These are side buttons, no front buttons. Exactly one orange control is the only saturated color anywhere.
The USB-C charging/data port must be centered on the narrow BOTTOM END FACE, perpendicular to the main front face, as in image 3. Remove the lower-front port seen in image 2: the front beneath the screen is an uninterrupted matte face except its small type. Show exactly one USB-C opening, at the middle of the bottom edge and middle of the body thickness.

THIS IMAGE IS VARIANT A — ALUMINUM MIDFRAME WITH SLA RESIN FRONT AND BACK COVERS:
The central structural perimeter / sidewall is genuine CNC aluminum, very finely bead-blasted natural silver satin anodized, uniformly low-gloss. The FRONT COVER and REAR COVER are opaque warm gray-white SLA PHOTOPOLYMER RESIN PRINTS, post-cured, finely sanded and evenly matte finished. The gray-white front is an inset cover bordered by the fine silver metal frame, akin to image 1. The frame subtly reaches around the front perimeter so the eye and hand can still perceive aluminum. The rear resin cover is precisely inset with a hairline seam and its pale edge just visible along the back side. Do not make a one-piece all-metal front, and do not make the frame plastic. Both large cover surfaces must visibly read as matte resin, with a material contrast to the soft satin sidewall. Very small precise joints, no bulky bands or ornamental trim, no shiny chamfers, no chrome, no visible front screws.
Retain a completely monochrome black and off-white display: three very thin radar rings, a small target and heading arrow, readings "168 m", "+62 m", small "DEMO". Clean glass with very little reflection, thin restrained black border.

Camera and scene:
A single entire device on its rear cover on a seamless warm very-light-gray tabletop/background, viewed from above the lower-right corner so the front, right controls and BOTTOM END FACE are simultaneously clearly visible. Portrait long axis runs predominantly UP-DOWN in the image, only a slight diagonal rotation; do not rotate the product into landscape orientation. Near-orthographic 100 mm product lens, deep depth of field, no cropping, generous margin, device occupies about two thirds of frame. Landscape 3:2 photograph. Flat, very soft diffuse skylight, almost shadowless pale studio, fine uniform matte textures, no metallic glare or strong shadows. Museum-object calm, exact typography, no props or hands, no captions or comparison panels, no logos other than the specified generic RID text.
Do not reproduce the green slider, blue button, decorative pattern, tick rings, extra ports or a horizontal/wide body.
variant_b_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit the supplied revised portrait RID product photograph to create its paired ALL-SLA-RESIN version. Use this image as the exact edit target.
CHANGE ONLY THE ENCLOSURE MATERIAL / SEAM EXPRESSION:
Replace every visible aluminum frame, perimeter lip and sidewall with opaque warm gray-white SLA PHOTOPOLYMER RESIN, the same uniformly fine matte material as the face. The entire exterior housing is now resin-printed, with no exposed aluminum frame, no silver perimeter band, no polished trim or metallic sheen. It should have the seamless, quiet continuous skin of original concept 2: a softly rounded, carefully sanded and matte-finished opaque resin body with a discreet hairline rear assembly seam. It is a whole resin enclosure concept, NOT translucent resin, NOT coarse layered FDM plastic and NOT a raw support-marked print. The metal INSIDE the USB-C connector may of course remain metal.
PRESERVE EXACTLY the target image's portrait silhouette, square AMOLED size and placement, lower-front Helvetica "RID" / "Model R-2" labeling, monochrome DEMO radar graphics, physical size, camera angle, product pose, scale in frame, lighting and warm light-gray background.
PRESERVE EXACTLY the right SIDE orange CIRCULAR lock button ABOVE the gray VERTICAL CAPSULE up/down rocker. Preserve the tiny black "LOCK" and black symbols. Orange is the only color accent.
PRESERVE EXACTLY the single USB-C opening centered on the actual BOTTOM END FACE; the lower FRONT face remains uninterrupted except its labels. No new front USB slot. No green or blue control, no extra features, no front buttons, no added type, no dimensions or captions.
The two photographs should look like the same product shot in the same camera setup with just the material construction changed. Ultra-clean Rams / Braun functionalist design, soft flat diffuse light, deep focus, extremely low glare.
